text:
Elaine P.: FYI — SI delivery hit a blocker on the K8s side for the Marketplace install. Customer cluster disallows <egress> except via their NAT GW and proxy. Installer fails pulling images.
Devin K.: ugh, classic. Error logs?
Elaine P.: paste from SI: 
```
Pulling image registry.redwood.ai/edge-agent:latest...
Error response from daemon: Get \"https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/\": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 10.0.0.5:3128: connect: network is unreachable
```
Raj T.: sounds like we need either registry CIDR whitelisted at their NAT or allowproxy exceptions. Do we know the proxy IPs?
Elaine P.: customer says they use a managed proxy pair with floating IP set, but ops can't guarantee static egress IPs for all EKS nodes. They asked if we can pre-pull images via initJob or use our offline bundle.
Laura M.: two options: 1) SI runs a node-init DaemonSet to prefetch images from a node with egress, 2) use our signed image bundle + local registry mirror. Both need a little config.
Devin K.: I can prototype a DaemonSet that pulls the required images before the marketplace helmrender. Quick snippet: 
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: prefetch-images
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: puller
        image: alpine:3.18
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","crictl pull registry.redwood.ai/edge-agent:latest && crictl pull registry.redwood.ai/optimizer:1.2.0"]
        securityContext:
          runAsUser: 0
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
```
Elaine P.: nice. SI note: they don't have crictl on nodes and prefer a Kubernetes-native approach.
Raj T.: alternative is a NetworkPolicy change to allow egress to registry CIDRs. If they can coordinate with netops to open to registry.redwood.ai (we own the range), we can provide the specific prefixes: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/26.
Laura M.: I'll attach the signed-bundle instructions and repo URL in a moment. If they can't modify network rules, pre-pull with a privileged DaemonSet might be the only path.
ops-bot: deployment failure detected — marketplace-install job failed (exit code 1) — see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/marketplace/2345
Devin K.: @Elaine P. recommend asking customer: can netops allow outbound to those two CIDRs for the install window? That avoids privileged pulls and keeps policies tight.
Elaine P.: pinged netops contact (cc @Raj T.). Waiting on a response.
Raj T.: if they ask for a temp solution, we can offer a small node with public egress (tunneled) to act as puller and then taint it so images get cached. Not ideal but works as a stopgap.
Laura M.: I uploaded the offline bundle here: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/offline-bundles/k8s-1.26/v1.2.0.tar.gz — includes step-by-step for local registry mirror.
Elaine P.: SI thanked us. We'll wait for netops answer. If no move in 2 hours, Devin — can you spin up the privileged DaemonSet POC?
Devin K.: yep, will do. Will post PR with commands and tl;dr for SI. :thumbsup:
Raj T.: note for runbook: add a task "verify registry egress or enable image prefetch" so on future installs we don't scramble.
Elaine P.: good call. Adding to the partner runbook now. Thanks team. :pray:
